# WorldClockOnRestartBeforeEvent Class

> [!CAUTION]
> This class is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Contains information related to a [*@minecraft/server.WorldClock*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/WorldClock.md) restarting.

## Properties

### **cancel**
`cancel: boolean;`

If set to true, cancels the world clock restart event. This will keep the world clock at the maximum time value and prevent it from ticking forward.

Type: *boolean*

### **clock**
`read-only clock: WorldClock;`

The world clock that is restarting.

Type: [*WorldClock*](WorldClock.md)

### **newTime**
`newTime: number;`

The time that the world clock will be set to after it restarts. If not set, the world clock will be set to 0.

Type: *number*

Notes:
  - This property has a minimum bound of `0`
